title: THE COMET'S SECOND TAIL
deck: A comet grows a tail that walks upwind, nine thousand young shells of living plasma sit across the grain lane, and a claim holder keeps the key to a sweep that would sterilize them.
shape: Interplanetary corridor crisis in six scenes: the ecology declines both offered paths, chooses a third, and has to be met at its own pace; the claim holder keeps the key throughout.

scenes.title: The Comb
paragraphs: *Oss Station, observation ring · Hour 0 of 40*

Eleven days out, the comet Maren-Quill had grown a second tail, and the second tail was walking the wrong way. The first streamed from the sun as tails should. The new one crawled up into the solar wind, a thin violet braid shedding knots of charged dust that tumbled across the freight corridor like seeds across a road.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Those knots are alive, in whatever sense a field can be. They fold dust into shells, and inside each shell something keeps a heartbeat on the low radio band. Nine thousand shells, mostly young, but their pulse bands show older keepers around the outer edge and newly folded shells inside. I told the council the knots are drawn to our ranging beams: every shell scatters our navigation. A beam comes out of that braid like light through frosted glass.

**Ibrahim Tadesse**  
Lamentine's sealed silos can feed its mills for eleven days, but Pelion has three days of grain and Kestrel two. The lane closes at perihelion in forty hours and stays closed six weeks. Ardent and the two other convoys must cross before then, or the outer stations eat seed stock before the next window.

**Dagny Voss, on the line**  
And the comet is mine, Councillor, under the Voss-Kane charter, down to the last gram of nickel. The charter lets a holder clear a hazard to navigation from her own claim. At Hour 12 I fire the comb. Forty minutes, and the lane is clean as glass.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
And so is the nursery. A magnetic sweep tears every shell apart.

**Dagny Voss, on the line**  
I read your paper, doctor. A pretty braid. Four hundred people draw wages from this claim, and they will not draw them from a braid.
Illuminara had stood at the window the whole time, watching the violet thread on the screen below the stars. Nobody had asked her opinion yet. She did not offer one.

**Illuminara**  
Not the summary. The raw tracks. Every knot, every minute since the braid formed.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
That is two terabytes of scribble.

**Illuminara**  
Then nobody has read it yet.

scenes.title: The Beacon That Lost Its Clock
paragraphs: *Oss Station, tracking bay · Hour 3*
She read the tracks the way she read a face, looking for the place where the expected thing failed to happen. It took her an hour and ten minutes. She found it in a gap forty minutes wide.
When the replay reached the fault, Illuminara named a 0.04-degree phase wobble 2.1 seconds before the instrument flag; the tracking technician checked the log and confirmed the lead.

**Illuminara**  
Beacon nine lost its clock at 22:10 yesterday — wall-clock time, before our forty-hour count began. Its phase wandered for forty minutes. Look at the knots in that stretch.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
They parted. Around the beacon, in a bubble. I took it for a sensor fault.

**Illuminara**  
They parted for exactly forty minutes and closed the moment the clock came back. You told the council the knots hunt the beams. A thing hunting beams would have swarmed the one that was shouting.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Unless they shun anything incoherent.

**Illuminara**  
And they are not drifting at random. Every strand runs along the old guide rails, the magnetic edges laid down to keep the beams clean. The rails are the quietest, straightest edges in forty million kilometres.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Then we built them a road. And we invited them onto it.

**Ngozi Farrant, on the line**  
Then cut the rails.

**Illuminara**  
Then your ranging goes with them, the lane turns to static, and I do not know what a young shell does when its road becomes noise.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Fracture. I would guess.

**Illuminara**  
It is a guess, and I would rather not learn the answer by being right. Suppose we offered something quieter, longer and cleaner than the rails, and led away from traffic.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
You are assuming they take offers.

**Illuminara**  
I am assuming nothing. I want to see whether they decline.

scenes.title: The Key
paragraphs: *Voss-Kane platform, comb control · Hour 6*
Dagny Voss kept the firing key on a cord around her own neck. Her engineer, Kemal Aydin, stood at the panel with his hands in his pockets, which Illuminara understood to be a courtesy.

**Dagny Voss**  
You have come to ask me to wait.

**Illuminara**  
I have come to ask what would make you not fire.

**Dagny Voss**  
A clean lane before Hour 12. Show me ranging lock to four metres, and I will not touch the key. I will also want to see the thing I am sparing. I do not break my own payroll over a diagram.

**Illuminara**  
Then take the heartbeat. Dr. Achterberg can put it on this panel. While the shells are whole it is a single clean note. We will log its starting width. If the note widens by more than five percent, the shells are falling out of step and the test has breached its limit.

**Kemal Aydin**  
Which means you are handing her the right to stop you.

**Illuminara**  
It was always hers.

**Dagny Voss**  
And if you are wrong, I want it on the record that I warned you, and that every hour I waited cost me a hauler contract.

**Illuminara**  
It will be on the record. The cost will be too.

**Dagny Voss**  
Then do it. At Hour 12 Kemal turns the comb unless the lane is improving and that note is within five percent of its starting width. If either measure turns against you, he holds the fields where they are and I decide whether you get one recovery window or the comb. I will not be asked twice.

scenes.title: Two Ribbons
paragraphs: *Oss and Lamentine field arrays · Hour 8 to Hour 10:30*

At Hour 8:10 the first ribbon ran out from Oss, south and away from the lane: a faint coherent edge, drawn as cleanly as the arrays could draw it. The second ran from Lamentine across the corridor, a decoy and a control. Illuminara wrote her prediction in the station log before either went live. The knots would leave the rails for the outbound ribbon within ninety minutes. If they took neither, or the crossing one, she was wrong, and she wrote that too.
They did nothing for seventy minutes. On Voss's panel the heartbeat held one clean note, and Aydin counted the minutes aloud in a flat voice.

At Hour 9:20 the knots moved. They did not take the outbound ribbon, and they did not take the crossing one. They settled on the seam where the two edges overlapped, a line nobody had drawn, running a hundred and forty kilometres along the lane's southern rail.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
They declined both.

**Illuminara**  
No. They chose the best edge in the sky, and I built it by accident. I had them picking between my offers.

**Ngozi Farrant, on the line**  
I will not enter above eighty metres. My fix just went to a hundred and twenty metres. Tell me that is the end of the bad news.

**Illuminara**  
It is the middle. I made the lane worse.
She said it once, at the volume she would have used for a measurement, and went back to the screen. It was Hour 10:35.

scenes.title: The Seam
paragraphs: *Oss field array, control room · Hour 10:40*

**Illuminara**  
The seam sits where the two ribbons are equal. Weaken the crossing one and strengthen the outbound one by the same amount, and the seam slides south without becoming brighter. Slide it slowly and the knots may follow it, because it remains coherent.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Or charged dust is simply collecting where the fields cancel. Then coherence has nothing to do with it.

**Kemal Aydin, on the line**  
I can rotate both phases equally and oppositely for forty seconds. The seam stays within two kilometres and total field strength within one percent, but the edge loses coherence. If the knots follow strength or geometry, they stay. If they follow coherence, their track should loosen before the six-minute mark.

**Illuminara**  
Freeze that prediction in the log. Forty seconds only. If the heartbeat widens by more than five percent, restore phase at once. If their track does not loosen within six minutes, my model fails and we do not begin the slide.

At Hour 10:47 Aydin rotated the phases. The seam did not move on the ranging plot. Seventy seconds later the outer knots lifted from it and began to wander, though the heartbeat remained narrow. He restored coherence at forty seconds; within four minutes the same knots had gathered along the seam again. They had not chosen either ribbon. They had answered a property of the edge.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
That defeats accumulation. It does not prove what they are, but it tells us what not to break.

**Illuminara**  
Then we move only one thing: the position of a coherent seam.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
The arrays cannot hold their phase that precisely. They wander. Noise is exactly what the knots flee.

**Illuminara**  
Then I will be the clock. I can feel which way each field is bending a breath before your instruments log it. I cannot move the knots, or the dust, or the shells. I can tell each of you which way you are drifting and by how much.

**Ibrahim Tadesse**  
Lamentine has eleven days of grain in sealed silos, but only fourteen hours of bread already baked. The mill reserve keeps the grinders and ovens alive through a brownout. Give it to the array and the mill stays cold until we release the field power. Households eat yesterday's loaves, and the outer stations still need these convoys.

**Illuminara**  
I will not pretend that is a small price.

**Ibrahim Tadesse**  
I authorize fourteen hours. The mill restarts the moment the array releases the reserve. Take it.

At Hour 11:00 she began calling corrections over two channels, one voice to Oss and one to Lamentine. At Hour 11:06 she called Oss drifting 0.18 degrees sunward; the instrument alarm crossed the same threshold 3.2 seconds later, and Aydin entered both times in Voss's log.

At Hour 11:29 Lamentine stepped against her call. This time the array alarm sounded 0.6 seconds before she corrected it. The outermost shells loosened for eleven seconds before the seam recovered. Her lead was real, and it was not constant enough to make the ecology safe by itself.
The seam crept south. The knots flowed along it like seeds along a tide line.
At Hour 11:41 Voss's voice came over the speaker, level and dry.

**Dagny Voss, on the line**  
The heartbeat is twelve percent broader. My line was five. Aydin has his hand on the comb.
Illuminara did not argue. She ordered the arrays held exactly where they were.

**Illuminara**  
The pull outran the young. The older keepers came with the seam and the newest shells could not keep the pace. I set the slope too fast. Give me until Hour 12:05 with the seam still. If the width is not within five percent of its starting line, turn the key. If it recovers, grant twenty minutes at half speed. Renew only while two ten-minute reads show the width holding and the ranging error falling.

**Dagny Voss, on the line**  
That is the recovery window. Five percent by Hour 12:05. After that, twenty minutes at a time. One bad pair of reads and Kemal fires without another speech.
At Hour 12:01 the heartbeat narrowed to four percent above its starting width. Aydin read the number himself. The laggards had caught up, and the braid closed behind them like a hand.

**Kemal Aydin, on the line**  
Four percent. Ranging error is falling. The condition is met.

**Dagny Voss, on the line**  
Resume. Half the speed. Your window ends at Hour 12:21 unless the next pair earns another.

scenes.title: Clean Glass
paragraphs: *Oss Station and the lane · Hour 15 to Hour 31*

By Hour 15 the seam lay two hundred kilometres south of the rail, and the braid lay with it, a long violet comma pointing away from the lane. Voss had renewed the twenty-minute window eight times, each after Aydin read two improving fixes and a heartbeat no more than five percent wide. Ranging lock came back in steps: eighty metres, forty, nine, four. At Hour 15:01, with the lane clean and the same limits holding, she converted the last interval into a standing order through the final crossing and Lamentine's controlled release.

Beyond the ribbons' crossing point, the comet's own southward field gradient ran parallel to the Oss outbound ribbon. Together they made the sole quiet edge; Lamentine's crossing array no longer set the seam's position. Aydin reduced that array in three logged steps, and the braid did not move or widen.

**Ngozi Farrant**  
Four. Four and holding. I said I would not enter above eighty metres, and I am entering at four on my own judgement, not because anyone told me it was safe. Ardent is in the lane.

Illuminara watched the scatter chart flatten on Oss's screen. The three convoys crossed one behind another, at half speed, through the narrow clean band, and the last cleared the closing line with nine hours to spare. Lamentine released its array at Hour 15:12 after the third stable step; the Oss ribbon and the comet's gradient held the braid on the new edge. The mill restarted on stored grain before the fourteen-hour bread shelf was empty. The convoys would reach the stations two days behind schedule; Pelion and Kestrel would receive them before either opened its seed stores.
Voss came to the observation ring herself, with the key on its cord. Tadesse joined by public line, carrying Oss Council's emergency navigation seal.

**Dagny Voss**  
A season. The north face remains mine, but I surrender extraction on the south face while the heartbeat band is active. That cost is mine, and the charter will say so in writing.

**Ibrahim Tadesse, on the line**  
Oss Council declares the same band a protected navigation exclusion through perihelion. Voss-Kane's assent and the public order expire together at the season's end unless both are renewed.

**Illuminara**  
It stopped being a diagram when each of you could measure what your choice would harm.

**Ibrahim Tadesse, on the line**  
The new beacons will be paid for by every hauler on the lane. Nobody has agreed to that yet.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Then that argument begins tomorrow. The next braid will not wait for us to finish it.

On the screen the heartbeat held its single clean note, and under it, new and faint, a second tone that had not been there before. Achterberg turned it up. Nobody could say what it meant, and Illuminara did not offer a guess. She asked, instead, that one ribbon be left on at a whisper through the season. Voss looked once at Aydin's trace, then nodded.

critic_line: A comet's second tail turns out to be a nursery that follows the coherence of an edge, and one claim holder's firing key becomes the instrument that lets a mistake be found, admitted and repaired in time.

literary_score.method: Independent GPT 7D SA1 and Claude PEC-6 v2 final scores; equal 50/50 model weight.
shared_strengths: Both judges found the physical crisis unusually legible: the field tests, failed first prediction and measurable recovery windows make the solution earned rather than effortless.
Both judges praised the distributed agency: the scientist, claim holder, array operator, council and convoy captain retain independent judgment, vetoes and visible costs.
shared_reservations: Both judges found the technical dialogue dense and sometimes more like a polished systems briefing than speech under pressure.
Both judges noted comparatively thin private interiority for the ensemble and a resolution whose immediate operational consequences are tightly controlled.

translation_sl.title: KOMETOV DRUGI REP
translation_sl.deck: Kometa dobi rep, ki potuje proti vetru, devet tisoč mladih lupin žive plazme leži čez žitni koridor, imetnica pravice pa hrani ključ za prečesavanje, ki bi jih steriliziralo.
translation_sl.shape: Kriza v medplanetarnem koridorju v šestih prizorih: ekologija zavrne obe ponujeni poti, izbere tretjo in srečati jo je treba v njenem lastnem ritmu; imetnica pravice ves čas obdrži ključ.

scenes.title: Glavnik
paragraphs: *Postaja Oss, opazovalni obroč · Ura 0 od 40*

Enajst dni pred perihelijem je kometu Maren-Quill zrasel drugi rep, ta pa se je premikal v napačno smer. Prvi je tekel stran od Sonca, kakor repi morajo. Novi se je plazil navzgor v sončni veter, tanka vijolična kita, ki je odmetavala vozle nabitega prahu; ti so se kotalili čez tovorni koridor kakor semena čez cesto.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Ti vozli so živi, v katerem koli pomenu je lahko živo polje. Prah zlagajo v lupine, v vsaki lupini pa nekaj ohranja srčni utrip na nizkem radijskem pasu. Devet tisoč lupin, večinoma mladih, toda njihovi pulzni pasovi kažejo starejše skrbnike ob zunanjem robu in na novo zložene lupine znotraj. Svetu sem povedala, da vozle privlačijo naši merilni žarki: vsaka lupina razprši našo navigacijo. Žarek pride iz te kite kakor svetloba skozi motno steklo.

**Ibrahim Tadesse**  
Lamentinovi zaprti silosi lahko njegove mline oskrbujejo enajst dni, vendar ima Pelion žita za tri dni, Kestrel pa za dva. Koridor se ob periheliju čez štirideset ur zapre in ostane zaprt šest tednov. Ardent in druga dva konvoja morajo prečkati pred tem, sicer bodo zunanje postaje pojedle semensko zalogo pred naslednjim oknom.

**Dagny Voss, po zvezi**  
Kometa pa je moja, svetnica, po listini Voss-Kane, do zadnjega grama niklja. Listina imetnici dovoljuje odstraniti nevarnost za plovbo z lastne pravice. Ob 12. uri sprožim glavnik. Štirideset minut in koridor bo čist kakor steklo.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
In z njim tudi jasli. Magnetno prečesavanje raztrga vsako lupino.

**Dagny Voss, po zvezi**  
Prebrala sem vaš članek, doktorica. Lepa kita. Štiristo ljudi prejema plačo od te pravice in ne bodo je prejemali od kite.
Illuminara je ves čas stala pri oknu in opazovala vijolično nit na zaslonu pod zvezdami. Nihče je še ni vprašal za mnenje. Ni ga ponudila.

**Illuminara**  
Ne povzetka. Surove sledi. Vsak vozel, vsako minuto od nastanka kite.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
To sta dva terabajta čečkanja.

**Illuminara**  
Potem tega še nihče ni prebral.

scenes.title: Svetilnik, ki je izgubil uro
paragraphs: *Postaja Oss, sledilni oddelek · Ura 3*
Sledi je brala, kakor je brala obraz, in iskala kraj, kjer se pričakovano ni zgodilo. Potrebovala je uro in deset minut. Našla ga je v štirideset minut dolgi vrzeli.
Ko je posnetek dosegel napako, je Illuminara 2,1 sekunde pred oznako instrumenta poimenovala fazno nihanje 0,04 stopinje; sledilni tehnik je preveril dnevnik in potrdil njeno prednost.

**Illuminara**  
Svetilnik devet je včeraj ob 22:10 izgubil uro — po stenskem času, preden se je začelo naše štirideseturno štetje. Njegova faza je tavala štirideset minut. Poglejte vozle v tem času.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Razmaknili so se. Okoli svetilnika, v mehurju. Imela sem ga za napako tipala.

**Illuminara**  
Razmaknili so se natanko za štirideset minut in se sklenili v trenutku, ko se je ura vrnila. Svetu ste povedali, da vozli lovijo žarke. Nekaj, kar lovi žarke, bi se zgnetlo okoli tistega, ki je kričal.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Razen če se izogibajo vsemu neskladnemu.

**Illuminara**  
In ne odnaša jih naključno. Vsaka nit teče vzdolž starih vodilnih tirnic, magnetnih robov, položenih zato, da bi žarki ostali čisti. Tirnice so najtišji, najravnejši robovi v štiridesetih milijonih kilometrov.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Potem smo jim zgradili cesto. In jih povabili nanjo.

**Ngozi Farrant, po zvezi**  
Potem prekinite tirnice.

**Illuminara**  
Potem z njimi izgine tudi vaše merjenje, koridor postane šum in ne vem, kaj naredi mlada lupina, ko njena cesta postane hrup.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Razpade. Tako bi ugibala.

**Illuminara**  
To je ugibanje in odgovora raje ne bi spoznala tako, da bi imela prav. Kaj če ponudimo nekaj tišjega, daljšega in čistejšega od tirnic, kar vodi stran od prometa?

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Predpostavljate, da sprejemajo ponudbe.

**Illuminara**  
Ničesar ne predpostavljam. Videti želim, ali jih zavrnejo.

scenes.title: Ključ
paragraphs: *Platforma Voss-Kane, nadzor glavnika · Ura 6*
Dagny Voss je ključ za sprožitev nosila na vrvici okoli lastnega vratu. Njen inženir Kemal Aydin je stal pri nadzorni plošči z rokami v žepih, kar je Illuminara razumela kot vljudnost.

**Dagny Voss**  
Prišli ste me prosit, naj čakam.

**Illuminara**  
Prišla sem vprašat, zaradi česa ne bi sprožili.

**Dagny Voss**  
Čist koridor pred 12. uro. Pokažite mi merilno fiksiranje na štiri metre in ključa se ne dotaknem. Videti hočem tudi stvar, ki ji prizanašam. Zaradi diagrama ne bom zlomila lastne plačilne liste.

**Illuminara**  
Potem vzemite srčni utrip. Doktorica Achterberg ga lahko prenese na to ploščo. Dokler so lupine cele, je to en sam čist ton. Zabeležili bomo njegovo začetno širino. Če se ton razširi za več kot pet odstotkov, lupine izgubljajo skupni ritem in preizkus je prestopil svojo mejo.

**Kemal Aydin**  
Kar pomeni, da ji izročate pravico, da vas ustavi.

**Illuminara**  
Vedno je bila njena.

**Dagny Voss**  
In če se motite, hočem v zapisniku, da sem vas posvarila in da me je vsaka ura čakanja stala pogodbe s tovornjakom.

**Illuminara**  
To bo v zapisniku. Tudi strošek bo.

**Dagny Voss**  
Potem storite. Ob 12. uri Kemal sproži glavnik, razen če se koridor izboljšuje in je ta ton znotraj petih odstotkov začetne širine. Če se katera koli mera obrne proti vam, obdrži polja tam, kjer so, jaz pa odločim, ali dobite eno obnovitveno okno ali glavnik. Dvakrat me ne boste prosili.

scenes.title: Dva trakova
paragraphs: *Poljske mreže Oss in Lamentine · Ura 8 do 10:30*

Ob 8:10 je iz Ossa stekel prvi trak, proti jugu in stran od koridorja: šibek skladen rob, izrisan tako čisto, kakor so ga mreže zmogle izrisati. Drugi je stekel iz Lamentina čez koridor, kot vaba in kontrola. Illuminara je napoved zapisala v postajni dnevnik, preden je kateri koli oživel. Vozli naj bi v devetdesetih minutah zapustili tirnice in odšli na izhodni trak. Če ne bi izbrali nobenega ali pa bi izbrali prečnega, bi se motila, in zapisala je tudi to.
Sedemdeset minut niso naredili ničesar. Na Vossini plošči je srčni utrip ohranjal en sam čist ton, Aydin pa je z ravnim glasom na glas štel minute.

Ob 9:20 so se vozli premaknili. Niso izbrali izhodnega traku in niso izbrali prečnega. Namestili so se na spoj, kjer sta se roba prekrivala, na črto, ki je ni narisal nihče in je tekla sto štirideset kilometrov vzdolž južne tirnice koridorja.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Oba so zavrnili.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Izbrali so najboljši rob na nebu in po nesreči sem ga zgradila jaz. Silila sem jih izbirati med mojima ponudbama.

**Ngozi Farrant, po zvezi**  
Ne bom vstopila nad osemdesetimi metri. Moje fiksiranje je pravkar poskočilo na sto dvajset metrov. Recite mi, da je to konec slabih novic.

**Illuminara**  
To je sredina. Poslabšala sem koridor.
Izrekla je enkrat, z glasnostjo, ki bi jo uporabila za meritev, in se vrnila k zaslonu. Bila je ura 10:35.

scenes.title: Spoj
paragraphs: *Poljska mreža Oss, nadzorna soba · Ura 10:40*

**Illuminara**  
Spoj leži tam, kjer sta trakova enaka. Oslabite prečnega in za enako vrednost okrepite izhodnega, pa spoj zdrsne proti jugu, ne da bi postal svetlejši. Premikajte ga počasi in vozli mu bodo morda sledili, ker ostaja skladen.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Ali pa se nabiti prah preprosto zbira tam, kjer se polji izničita. Potem skladnost s tem nima ničesar.

**Kemal Aydin, po zvezi**  
Obe fazi lahko za štirideset sekund zavrtim enako in v nasprotni smeri. Spoj ostane znotraj dveh kilometrov, skupna jakost polja pa znotraj enega odstotka, vendar rob izgubi skladnost. Če vozli sledijo jakosti ali geometriji, ostanejo. Če sledijo skladnosti, bi se morala njihova sled zrahljati pred šesto minuto.

**Illuminara**  
To napoved zamrznite v dnevniku. Samo štirideset sekund. Če se srčni utrip razširi za več kot pet odstotkov, nemudoma obnovite fazo. Če se njihova sled v šestih minutah ne zrahlja, moj model odpove in drsenja ne začnemo.

Ob 10:47 je Aydin zavrtel fazi. Spoj se na merilnem prikazu ni premaknil. Sedemdeset sekund pozneje so se zunanji vozli dvignili z njega in začeli tavati, srčni utrip pa je ostal ozek. Po štiridesetih sekundah je obnovil skladnost; v štirih minutah so se isti vozli znova zbrali vzdolž spoja. Niso izbrali nobenega traku. Odgovorili so na lastnost roba.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
To ovrže kopičenje. Ne dokazuje, kaj so, pove pa nam, česa ne smemo zlomiti.

**Illuminara**  
Potem premaknemo samo eno stvar: položaj skladnega spoja.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Mreži ne moreta tako natančno ohranjati faze. Tavata. Vozli bežijo prav pred šumom.

**Illuminara**  
Potem bom jaz ura. Začutim lahko, v katero smer se vsako polje upogiba, en dih preden to zapišejo vaši instrumenti. Ne morem premakniti vozlov, prahu ali lupin. Vsakemu izmed vas lahko povem, v katero smer vas odnaša in za koliko.

**Ibrahim Tadesse**  
Lamentine ima v zaprtih silosih žita za enajst dni, vendar le štirinajst ur že pečenega kruha. Rezerva mlina ohranja mline in peči pri življenju med izpadom elektrike. Dajte jo mreži in mlin ostane hladen, dokler ne sprostimo poljske moči. Gospodinjstva bodo jedla včerajšnje hlebce, zunanje postaje pa te konvoje še vedno potrebujejo.

**Illuminara**  
Ne bom se pretvarjala, da je to majhna cena.

**Ibrahim Tadesse**  
Odobrim štirinajst ur. Mlin se znova zažene v trenutku, ko mreža sprosti rezervo. Vzemite jo.

Ob 11:00 je začela sporočati popravke po dveh kanalih, z enim glasom Ossu in drugim Lamentinu. Ob 11:06 je povedala, da Oss odnaša za 0,18 stopinje proti Soncu; alarm instrumenta je isti prag prestopil 3,2 sekunde pozneje, Aydin pa je oba časa vpisal v Vossin dnevnik.

Ob 11:29 je Lamentine stopil proti njenemu navodilu. Tokrat se je alarm mreže oglasil 0,6 sekunde, preden ga je popravila. Najbolj zunanje lupine so se razrahljale za enajst sekund, preden se je spoj obnovil. Njena prednost je bila resnična in ne dovolj stalna, da bi sama po sebi zagotovila varnost ekologije.
Spoj je lezel proti jugu. Vozli so tekli vzdolž njega kakor semena vzdolž črte plime.
Ob 11:41 se je iz zvočnika oglasil Vossin glas, raven in suh.

**Dagny Voss, po zvezi**  
Srčni utrip je dvanajst odstotkov širši. Moja meja je bila pet. Aydin ima roko na glavniku.
Illuminara ni ugovarjala. Ukazala je, naj mreži ostaneta natanko tam, kjer sta.

**Illuminara**  
Vleka je prehitela mlade. Starejši skrbniki so šli s spojem, najnovejše lupine pa niso zmogle tempa. Naklon sem nastavila prehitro. Dajte mi čas do 12:05 in spoj naj miruje. Če širina ni znotraj petih odstotkov začetne črte, obrnite ključ. Če si opomore, odobrite dvajset minut pri polovični hitrosti. Podaljšajte samo, dokler dva desetminutna odčitka kažeta, da širina drži, napaka merjenja pa pada.

**Dagny Voss, po zvezi**  
To je obnovitveno okno. Pet odstotkov do 12:05. Nato po dvajset minut naenkrat. En slab par odčitkov in Kemal sproži brez novega govora.
Ob 12:01 se je srčni utrip zožil na štiri odstotke nad začetno širino. Aydin je številko prebral sam. Zaostali so ujeli druge in kita se je za njimi zaprla kakor dlan.

**Kemal Aydin, po zvezi**  
Štirje odstotki. Napaka merjenja pada. Pogoj je izpolnjen.

**Dagny Voss, po zvezi**  
Nadaljujte. Polovična hitrost. Vaše okno se konča ob 12:21, razen če si naslednji par prisluži novega.

scenes.title: Čisto steklo
paragraphs: *Postaja Oss in koridor · Ura 15 do 31*

Do 15. ure je spoj ležal dvesto kilometrov južno od tirnice, z njim pa tudi kita, dolga vijolična vejica, obrnjena stran od koridorja. Voss je dvajsetminutno okno podaljšala osemkrat, vsakič potem, ko je Aydin prebral dve izboljšani fiksiranji in srčni utrip, širok največ pet odstotkov. Merilno fiksiranje se je vračalo po korakih: osemdeset metrov, štirideset, devet, štiri. Ob 15:01, ko je bil koridor čist in so iste meje še vedno držale, je zadnji interval spremenila v trajni ukaz do končnega prečkanja in Lamentinovega nadzorovanega izklopa.

Onkraj presečišča trakov je lastni južni gradient kometovega polja tekel vzporedno z Ossovim izhodnim trakom. Skupaj sta tvorila edini tihi rob; Lamentinova prečna mreža ni več določala položaja spoja. Aydin je to mrežo zmanjšal v treh zabeleženih korakih in kita se ni premaknila ali razširila.

**Ngozi Farrant**  
Štiri. Štiri in drži. Rekla sem, da ne bom vstopila nad osemdesetimi metri, vstopam pa pri štirih po lastni presoji, ne zato, ker mi je kdo rekel, da je varno. Ardent je v koridorju.

Illuminara je opazovala, kako se graf razpršitve na Ossovem zaslonu izravnava. Trije konvoji so prečkali drug za drugim, s polovično hitrostjo, skozi ozek čisti pas, zadnji pa je črto zapiranja prešel z devetimi urami prednosti. Lamentine je svojo mrežo sprostil ob 15:12 po tretjem stabilnem koraku; Ossov trak in kometov gradient sta kito zadržala na novem robu. Mlin se je znova zagnal z uskladiščenim žitom, preden se je iztekla štirinajsturna zaloga kruha. Konvoji bi do postaj prišli dva dni pozneje od načrta; Pelion in Kestrel bi ju prejela, preden bi kateri koli odprl svojo semensko zalogo.
Voss je sama prišla v opazovalni obroč s ključem na vrvici. Tadesse se je pridružil po javni zvezi in nosil nujni navigacijski pečat sveta Oss.

**Dagny Voss**  
Eno sezono. Severna stran ostane moja, vendar se odpovedujem izkopavanju na južni strani, dokler je pas srčnega utripa dejaven. Ta strošek je moj in v listini bo tako pisalo.

**Ibrahim Tadesse, po zvezi**  
Svet Oss razglaša isti pas za zaščiteno navigacijsko izključitveno območje do perihelija. Soglasje Voss-Kane in javni odlok prenehata skupaj ob koncu sezone, razen če sta oba obnovljena.

**Illuminara**  
Diagram je prenehal biti v trenutku, ko je lahko vsak izmed vas izmeril, čemu bi njegova izbira škodovala.

**Ibrahim Tadesse, po zvezi**  
Nove svetilnike bo plačal vsak tovornjak na koridorju. S tem se še ni strinjal nihče.

**Sunniva Achterberg**  
Potem se ta spor začne jutri. Naslednja kita ne bo čakala, da ga končamo.

Na zaslonu je srčni utrip ohranjal svoj en sam čist ton, pod njim pa je bil nov, šibek drugi ton, ki ga prej ni bilo. Achterberg ga je ojačala. Nihče ni mogel povedati, kaj pomeni, in Illuminara ni ponudila ugibanja. Namesto tega je prosila, naj en trak skozi sezono ostane prižgan na šepetu. Voss je enkrat pogledala Aydinovo sled in nato prikimala.

translation_sl.critic_line: Kometov drugi rep se izkaže za jasli, ki sledijo skladnosti roba, ključ za sprožitev ene imetnice pravice pa postane instrument, s katerim je mogoče napako pravočasno odkriti, priznati in popraviti.
